title: Options Trading Complete
subtitle: Contract mechanics, the Greeks, pricing intuition, long options and vertical spreads, expiration risk and sizing, on one worked chain from start to finish.
what_you_learn: What an option contract is: the 100 multiplier, the OCC guarantee, expiration, exercise and assignment, and American versus European style
How to read a chain and price its parts: bid/ask, volume and open interest, moneyness, intrinsic and time value, and the round-trip cost hurdle
Delta, theta, vega and gamma as working numbers: delta as probability, leverage and hedge ratio; the decay curve; IV rank and the vol surface; why 0DTE moves violently
Pricing without calculus: put-call parity, what each Black-Scholes input does, and a one-step binomial tree
Long calls and puts with strike, DTE and exit rules, and all four vertical spreads with payoff, break-even and margin math
Expiration mechanics (pin risk, assignment, early exercise around dividends), fixed-fraction position sizing, and a 22-point pre-trade checklist
